notes: Optional fluxmux_config.json key RescueAdapters: the Hail Mary 'can't continue — rebuild from outside' rescue, per Client app. Copy objects into that file — do not replace the whole config. Built-in cline-compaction-file and harness-session-log still run unless you list the same id with enabled false (or with your own steps). One entry per Client app that rebuilds its chat from a file it reads by itself. Steps run in order: find the newest chat file -> stop the Client app (if it holds the file) -> back it up -> steps -> reopen the same chat. Text takes placeholders {summary} {summaryJson} {summaryFile} {sessionId} {sessionDir} {sessionFile} {keepRecent} {rescueScripts} {nowMs} and %ENV% variables. Step kinds: command (exe, args, timeoutSeconds, expectJsonOk), write-file (path, content), delete (path), builtin (name). Stop kinds: none, process (target = program name), harness-web. Reopen kinds: none, url (target), command (target, args), harness-web. Test a new entry on a copy of a chat first.

RescueAdapters.label: Harness can't continue — rebuild & reopen this chat
RescueAdapters.doneMessage: Harness was restarted on the same chat. The older part of the chat is now a summary from AI-FluxMux, and the most recent messages are kept — carry on in that chat.

RescueAdapters.label: Example Client can't continue — rebuild & reopen
RescueAdapters.doneMessage: The chat was rebuilt from AI-FluxMux's session note and reopened.
